title: BLR CSP predicate
statement: Let $x$ and $y$ be functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements. The associated predicate is the predicate of their BLR constraint: it specifies a linear equation with right-hand side zero, of arity one when $x=0$, $y=0$, or $x=y$, and of arity three otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Two functions from an $n$-element index set to the field with two elements
